hints.title: Capacity-Bounded Buffer Synchronization
hints.text: A fixed-capacity buffer must block producer threads when internal storage is full and block consumer threads when storage is empty. How do condition monitors coordinate capacity states?

hints.title: Dual Condition Formulation
hints.text: Guard the internal buffer with a mutual exclusion lock. Use condition variables to notify awaiting consumers when an element arrives and notify awaiting producers when a slot frees up.

hints.title: While Loop Invariant Check
hints.text: Always check queue fullness and emptiness inside while loops before proceeding to defend against spurious wakeups. Signal the counterpart condition after modifying queue state.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import threading
from collections import deque

class BoundedBlockingQueue:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.queue = deque()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.not_full = threading.Condition(self.lock)
        self.not_empty = threading.Condition(self.lock)

    def enqueue(self, element: int) -> None:
        with self.not_full:
            while len(self.queue) >= self.capacity:
                self.not_full.wait()
            self.queue.append(element)
            self.not_empty.notify()

    def dequeue(self) -> int:
        with self.not_empty:
            while len(self.queue) == 0:
                self.not_empty.wait()
            val = self.queue.popleft()
            self.not_full.notify()
            return val

    def size(self) -> int:
        with self.lock:
            return len(self.queue)
```

variables: C: capacity limit of the bounded queue
complexity.notes: Enqueue and dequeue operations perform amortized O(1) buffer mutations under condition synchronization.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unsynchronized collections result in lost updates, race conditions on length calculations, and deadlocks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memory bounded strictly by capacity C prevents unbounded heap exhaustion under rapid producers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of while loop guards around wait() calls to guard against spurious wakeups.

solutions.approach: Monitor pattern with dual condition variables
ReentrantLock with notFull and notEmpty conditions
